chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Sayyari from Ali ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid from one of his companions from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he complained to him about phlegm, so he said:
'Is there a slave girl for you who makes you laugh?' He said, 'I said, No.' He said, 'So take her, for that cuts down the phlegm.'
ai.seo_question: What medical or health advice did Imam al-Sadiq give regarding phlegm and laughter?
ai.summary: In this practical medical advice from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the connection between emotional joy and physical health is highlighted, reflecting the Shia understanding of the mind-body unity. The recommendation to acquire a slave girl for her humor underscores the cultural context of domestic companionship as a therapeutic means to alleviate respiratory ailments through the physiological benefits of laughter.
